title: 'Youth & students more important than any post': Amit Shah on Pradhan's resignation
content: Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated the country and students are more important than any position. He reaffirmed the Modi government's commitment to reforms against paper leaks. Dharmendra Pradhan resigned as Union Education Minister amid nationwide protests over the NEET-UG paper leak. Pralhad Joshi was given additional charge of the education ministry later that day. The government respects youth sentiments and ensures justice for NEET aspirants.

title: Ram Temple donation theft row: UP govt reconstitutes SIT; IG Kiran S to lead probe
content: Uttar Pradesh government formed a new SIT to investigate alleged embezzlement of temple offerings.  This team, led by senior IPS officers, replaces the earlier investigation panel.  The Supreme Court directed the state to form a fresh SIT under a senior IPS officer.  Investigators previously examined financial records and questioned temple staff about donation irregularities.  The new SIT will submit its findings to the Supreme Court on July 27.

title: Quashing of FIRs, compensation & 5-point Charter: What Centre, CJP said in joint press meet
content: The Cockroach Janta Party ended its 36-day protest at Jantar Mantar. This decision followed three rounds of talks with the central government delegation. The government accepted two key demands, including the minister's resignation. All legal cases filed against protesters and organizers will now be withdrawn. The party continues to pursue compensation for families affected by the NEET paper leak.

title: Jeff Bezos ex-wife MacKenzie Scott helped write a 'donation playbook' for Snap founder
content: Snap co-founder Evan Spiegel and Miranda Kerr have donated $550 million to erase medical debt. This significant contribution will benefit over 261,000 Californians facing financial hardship. The donation follows a philanthropic model pioneered by MacKenzie Scott. Undue Medical Debt will administer the funds, targeting vulnerable residents statewide. This initiative aims to unburden families from unpayable medical expenses.

title: 'Sab jhandu kar diya': India's CWG medallist reveals the painful story behind his name
content: Jhandu Kumar secured India's first medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games. He won bronze in para powerlifting after successful lifts of 181kg and 190kg.  His journey began with polio and taunts over a name born from hardship.  Kumar previously worked as an e-rickshaw driver to fund his training.  He now aims to break records at future Para Asian Games and Paralympics.

title: 'My bad': Ishan Kishan's hilarious run-out blunder goes viral — Watch
content: Ishan Kishan's spectacular 81 powered India to a series-clinching T20 victory over Zimbabwe. He also provided amusement with a missed run-out opportunity during the match. India secured a commanding 90-run win, taking an unassailable 2-0 lead. Kishan's performance overshadowed a fielding lapse, which he later joked about. The team's bowlers also contributed significantly to the dominant series triumph.

title: US govt updates list of H-1B debarred & disqualified companies; what it means
content: The US Department of Labor has updated its list of H-1B visa program violators. Four companies are now temporarily barred from filing H-1B petitions. GowraTech, LLC and Renotek Group LLC face debarment until 2027. Seeloz, Inc. and Sherwood Academy are barred until 2028. This action affects employers found to be willful violators of program rules.

title: New England's solar panels paid off big during the 2026 heatwave
content: According to a new report from Acadia Center, during the heat wave that hit New England between June 28 and July 4, distributed solar projects contributed more than six gigawatts in electricity, saving ratepayers about $130-$149 million collectively.On July 2 alone, the report found that solar arrays saved $39 million to $54 million and solar contributed more power to the grid than the region's nuclear fleet that afternoon.

title: North Carolina rebuilt its elk population; to allow 2 hunts in 2027
content: North Carolina will allow its first elk hunt in 2027, 25 years after reintroducing the species. Only two hunting permits will be issued through an auction and raffle, with proceeds supporting elk conservation. Wildlife officials say the population is now sustainable, while some local residents remain divided over whether hunting should begin.

title: Elon Musk's SpaceX in talks to sell Pentagon billions in AI data-centre capacity
content: SpaceX is discussing a multi-billion dollar deal with the US Defense Department. This agreement would provide data-center capacity for advanced artificial intelligence models. The Pentagon seeks to secure high-end compute power for its agencies and military units. SpaceX has recently signed similar cloud-compute deals with other major tech companies. This potential pact would significantly expand SpaceX's role in national security infrastructure.

title: 'Rajesh Khanna wanted divorce from Dimple, but she refused,' says his partner
content: Anita Advani sought legal recognition for her relationship with Rajesh Khanna. The Bombay High Court dismissed her appeal, citing it as a live-in relationship. Advani stated Khanna repeatedly sought divorce from Dimple Kapadia, which was refused. She highlighted the legal complexities of relationships when a formal divorce is absent. The court's decision left Advani without legal standing for her long-term association.

title: CWG Day 3: No medals for India, but Sachin Siwach advances and Rupa-Pinki stay unbeaten
content: Sachin Siwach advanced in boxing while Rupa Rani Tirkey and Pinki Singh continued their lawn bowls unbeaten streak. India's artistic gymnastics team secured fifth place in their subdivision competition.  Both swimmers failed to reach the 400m freestyle final, ending their pool challenge.  The women's wheelchair basketball team faced a significant defeat against Wales.

title: Patrick Mahomes says wife and kids gave meaning to his NFL greatness
content: Patrick Mahomes says his greatest strength is not just football but the support of his family. From overcoming injuries to balancing life as a husband and father, he credits Brittany Mahomes and their children for keeping him grounded. His emotional words and never-give-up mindset show that resilience, patience and love have shaped both his life and his legendary NFL career.

title: Gabriel Langton remains conscious after horrific Commonwealth Games fall
content: Gabriel Langton suffered a horrific fall during the men's team gymnastics final at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow after missing a catch on the high bar. The England gymnast was treated on the arena floor before being taken to hospital in a neck brace. Team England later shared an encouraging update on his condition. Here's everything we know about how the accident happened, the latest injury update, his current condition, and what it could mean for his recovery and return to competition.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes turned family grief into a mission of hope
content: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes attended a back-to-school event with FARE just before Chiefs training camp, continuing their advocacy for food allergy awareness. The couple's mission comes from personal experience after their children, Sterling and Bronze, were diagnosed with food allergies. Brittany has previously shared the frightening details of Bronze's severe allergic reaction and how it inspired the family to help others. Here's how Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes are using their platform to support parents and create safer environments for children with food allergies.

title: Energy security: What India’s crude, LPG & LNG strategic reserves strategy should look like
content: Once completed, the total strategic petroleum reserves capacity will increase to 11.88 MMT, enabling India to move significantly closer to the 90-day reserve target. India is working with the UAE for 30 million barrels of crude of storage capacity.

title: ‘It's all about the attitude’: Shreyas hails young India after first series win as captain
content: India secured a dominant series victory against Zimbabwe under Shreyas Iyer's leadership.  Ishan Kishan and Tilak Varma's aggressive batting propelled India to a substantial total.  The bowlers then effectively restricted Zimbabwe to a manageable score in the second match.  This series win highlighted the young team's positive and attacking approach to the game.

title: Ramayana trailer leak fallout: Fans slam security lapses; urge official release
content: The Ramayana trailer release, planned for July 24, 2026, has been unexpectedly postponed.  Multiple leaked clips from the unreleased promo have now appeared online, sparking fan discussion.  Viewers expressed excitement about the film's grand scale and visuals despite the footage quality.  Concerns were raised about security measures failing to prevent the trailer's premature online debut.  The makers have yet to announce a revised release date for the official trailer.

title: Who is Pralhad Joshi? 5-time MP who took charge of education ministry after Pradhan's exit
content: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi on Saturday was assigned the charge of the Ministry of Education after President Droupadi Murmu accepted the resignation of Dharmendra Pradhan from the Union Council of Ministers owing to widespread student-led protests across the nation over the NEET paper leak.

title: Shabana Azmi tests positive for H1N1, says she's in isolation but getting on-ground protest updates
content: Shabana Azmi has tested positive for H1N1 and swine flu, running a 102-degree fever, and will isolate for five days. Despite missing the protests, she remains in touch with on-ground updates and expressed solidarity via a post featuring her father Kaifi Azmi's poem. She was earlier an active presence at the demonstrations before falling ill.

title: India crush Zimbabwe by 90 runs as Shreyas Iyer clinches first series win as captain
content: Chasing 220, Zimbabwe's task became difficult after losing five wickets inside the first nine overs. They were eventually bowled out for 129.

title: One post, 6 words, 37 days, one resignation: How 'cockroaches' crawled into corridors of power
content: A six-word post on X sparked a massive student protest across India.  Thousands of students demanded accountability for examination irregularities and unemployment issues.  The sustained demonstrations pressured the government for over a month.  Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan eventually resigned from his post.  The movement, born online, achieved significant governmental concessions and assurances.

title: Watch: Gymnast Gabriel Langton suffers frightening head-first fall at CWG 2026
content: England gymnast Gabriel Langton suffered a severe head-first fall during the men's team final.  This terrifying incident cast a shadow over the competition and halted proceedings.  Canada secured their first men's team gymnastics gold medal in twenty years.  Rival gymnasts expressed concern and offered support for the injured athlete.  Langton was conscious and speaking with doctors before being taken to hospital.

title: Pradhan quits: What oppn can learn from CJP-led students protest
content: In a remarkable turn of events, student protests led to resignation of Union minister Dharmendra Pradhan, showcasing the power of grassroots activism. The Cockroach Janata Party, born from online memes, played a pivotal role in this uprising. Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike also fueled the movement's progress, raising critical questions for opposition parties regarding their involvement in such significant demonstrations.

title: Watch: Haaland brings 'Viking row' to Donnarumma's wedding as WC craze lives on
content: Manchester City striker Erling Haaland led guests in the Viking row celebration. This famous chant became synonymous with Norway's World Cup campaign. The event occurred during teammate Gianluigi Donnarumma's wedding festivities in Italy. Many prominent football personalities attended the lavish ceremony. Haaland's revival ensured the celebration's continued resonance with fans.

title: India script history, equal world record for most 200-plus T20I totals in a year
content: India achieved their ninth 200-plus total in T20Is for 2026. This performance matches their own world record set previously in 2024. Ishan Kishan and Tilak Varma led the strong batting effort against Zimbabwe. They built crucial partnerships after an early batting collapse. India's batting continues to set new standards in the shortest format.

title: Dharmendra Pradhan resigns as Union education minister amid massive student protests
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his position. He submitted his resignation letter to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This action comes amid ongoing protests concerning the NEET paper leak. The government has taken immediate cognizance of the irregularities. Investigations were handed over to the CBI, and the exam was cancelled.

title: Karnataka boy with no internet builds space startup working with NASA
content: Awais Ahmed's startup Pixxel secured a NASA contract for Earth-observation data.  His parents nurtured his curiosity with books, which sparked his interest in space.  He pursued engineering at BITS Pilani and met his co-founder there.  Together, they founded Pixxel to build a constellation of hyperspectral satellites.  This journey highlights the impact of early curiosity and parental investment.

title: Pakistan's embarrassing blunder, field six players in five-a-side hockey game vs India
content: The incident took place on Friday shortly after the match began, when the umpires noticed Pakistan had six players on the field. Under the rules of the five-a-side format, only five players are allowed.

title: Student leader to education minister: Dharmendra Pradhan's political career before NEET row
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his post on Saturday. He submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Narendra Modi due to ongoing protests. Pradhan's tenure saw the implementation of the National Education Policy 2020. His political journey began in student politics in Odisha many years ago. He previously held key portfolios in the Union government since 2014.

title: Watch: Drop Shot Ep. 4 | Jana Nayagan Fever, The Keeper of the Wells & Gaurav Gupta’s Light Song
content:
In this episode, we capture the excitement surrounding Vijay’s Jana Nayagan as fans celebrate what could be the actor’s final film and director H. Vinoth shares insights into the much-awaited release. 
We then explore The Keeper of the Wells, as Chennai-based author Zhayynn James discusses his debut novel inspired by the historic Seven Wells neighbourhood of North Chennai.
